trip_options.title: Budget Explorer - Disney World, Orlando, Florida
trip_options.description: Save money without sacrificing the experience. Perfect for travelers who value authentic local experiences over luxury.

hotel.name: Aegean Bliss Resort, Disney World, Orlando, Florida

day_by_day.morning: N/A - Flight arrives at 13:00
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Orlando International Airport at 13:00. Take the Disney's Magical Express or a budget rideshare (Lyft/Uber) to Aegean Bliss Resort. Check in, unpack, and get oriented with the resort amenities. Pick up a free Disney resort map and plan your week. Head to the resort pool for a relaxing swim to beat the Florida heat.
day_by_day.evening: Take the free Disney resort shuttle to Disney Springs (no park ticket required). Explore the outdoor shopping and entertainment district for free. Window shop, enjoy street performers, and soak in the Disney atmosphere. Walk around the waterfront area.

meals.breakfast: N/A - in transit
meals.lunch: Grab a quick and affordable bite at the airport before or after landing — try Chick-fil-A or Subway in the terminal (~$10-12)
meals.dinner: Disney Springs: Earl of Sandwich for a budget-friendly hot sandwich meal (~$10-13 per person). Great value and very popular.

day_by_day.notes: Purchase a multi-day Magic Your Way ticket in advance online for the best savings. Download the My Disney Experience app for free to check wait times, make dining reservations, and navigate parks. Stay hydrated — June in Orlando is hot and humid (90°F+). Pack sunscreen and refillable water bottles.

day_by_day.morning: Rise early (7:00 AM) and head to Magic Kingdom — the most iconic Disney park. Arrive at rope drop (park opening) to beat the crowds. Hit the most popular rides first: Space Mountain, Big Thunder Mountain Railroad, and Seven Dwarfs Mine Train. Use the free Lightning Lane Single Pass strategically for top rides.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore Fantasyland and Tomorrowland. Catch the Festival of Fantasy Parade (check app for timing). Take a break from the heat with a ride on Pirates of the Caribbean or the Haunted Mansion (both indoor and air-conditioned). Grab a mid-afternoon snack and rest your feet.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for the iconic Happily Ever After fireworks show over Cinderella Castle (usually around 9:00 PM — confirm in app). This is a must-see and completely included with park admission. Exit after the show using resort shuttle back to hotel.

meals.breakfast: Quick-service breakfast at the hotel or pack granola bars and fruit from a grocery run to save money (~$3-5)
meals.lunch: Columbia Harbour House in Liberty Square — affordable quick-service with clam chowder, sandwiches, and fish & chips (~$12-15 per person)
meals.dinner: Pecos Bill Tall Tale Inn & Cafe in Frontierland — tacos, burgers, and rice bowls with a free toppings bar (~$13-16 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Magic Kingdom is the busiest park — arriving at rope drop is essential on a budget to maximize time without paying for extra Lightning Lane passes. Bring a poncho; afternoon thunderstorms are common in June. Free water is available at any quick-service location upon request.

day_by_day.morning: Head to EPCOT for a full day. Arrive early and start in World Discovery — ride Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind (virtual queue via app — set an alarm!) and Test Track. Then head to Mission: SPACE for a thrilling astronaut simulation experience.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore World Showcase, which opens at 11:00 AM. Walk through the 11 international pavilions — Mexico, Norway, China, Germany, Italy, America, Japan, Morocco, France, UK, and Canada. Each pavilion has free entertainment, cultural exhibits, and unique architecture. Ride Frozen Ever After in the Norway pavilion.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for EPCOT's LUMINOUS The Symphony of Us nighttime spectacular over World Showcase Lagoon. Grab a spot around the lagoon 30-45 minutes early for a good view. Free with park admission and absolutely stunning.

meals.breakfast: Hotel quick-service or packed snacks (~$3-5)
meals.lunch: Sunshine Seasons in The Land pavilion — one of EPCOT's best quick-service spots with fresh, affordable options like rotisserie chicken and sandwiches (~$12-14)
meals.dinner: World Showcase food booths — budget-friendly way to sample international cuisine. Try a beef empanada from Mexico (~$6), school bread from Norway (~$5), and a crepe from France (~$7). Mix and match for a fun, affordable dinner (~$18-22 total)

day_by_day.notes: EPCOT is very walkable but large — comfortable shoes are a must. The World Showcase is a wonderful free cultural experience even without riding attractions. Check the My Disney Experience app for live entertainment schedules in each pavilion — many performances are free and excellent.

day_by_day.morning: Visit Hollywood Studios. Arrive at rope drop and head straight to Star Wars: Rise of the Resistance — one of the most immersive theme park attractions ever built. Then ride Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run in Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge. Explore the fully immersive Star Wars land.
day_by_day.afternoon: Head to Toy Story Land for Slinky Dog Dash and Alien Swirling Saucers. Then experience Tower of Terror and Rock 'n' Roller Coaster in the Sunset Boulevard area. Catch a live Indiana Jones Epic Stunt Spectacular show (check app for times) — free with admission and very entertaining.
day_by_day.evening: Watch the Fantasmic! nighttime show at the Hollywood Hills Amphitheater — an epic outdoor water, fire, and projection show. Arrive 45-60 minutes early for good seats. This is included with park admission and is one of Disney's best live shows.

meals.breakfast: Pack breakfast from hotel to eat on the shuttle (~$3-5)
meals.lunch: Woody's Lunch Box in Toy Story Land — fun theming and affordable toasted sandwiches and lunch box tarts (~$11-14 per person)
meals.dinner: ABC Commissary near Echo Lake — quick-service with burgers, wraps, and flatbreads at reasonable prices (~$12-15 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Hollywood Studios has some of the longest waits in all of Walt Disney World. Rise of the Resistance and Slinky Dog Dash should be prioritized at rope drop. The park is more compact than others, so it's manageable in one day if you're strategic. Check show schedules on the app the night before.

day_by_day.morning: Visit Animal Kingdom — Disney's largest park by land area. Arrive at rope drop and head directly to Avatar Flight of Passage in Pandora – The World of Avatar. This is consistently the highest-rated attraction at Walt Disney World. Then ride Na'vi River Journey for a gentler experience through the bioluminescent forest.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore Africa and ride Kilimanjaro Safaris — a real open-air safari through 110 acres with live African animals including lions, elephants, giraffes, and rhinos. Walk the Gorilla Falls Exploration Trail for free wildlife viewing. Head to Asia for Expedition Everest roller coaster and Kali River Rapids (you WILL get wet).
day_by_day.evening: Experience Rivers of Light or the Tree of Life Awakenings — the Tree of Life comes alive with projected animal stories after dark. A magical and free experience included with admission. Head back to the resort for an early night to rest tired feet.

meals.breakfast: Hotel or packed snacks
meals.lunch: Flame Tree Barbecue in Discovery Island — one of the best quick-service meals in all of Disney. Ribs, chicken, and pulled pork with beautiful outdoor waterfront seating (~$14-17 per person)
meals.dinner: Satu'li Canteen in Pandora — customizable rice and noodle bowls with fresh ingredients. Healthy, filling, and great value for Disney (~$13-16 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Animal Kingdom is best experienced in the morning when animals are most active on the safari. Bring a change of clothes or a poncho for Kali River Rapids — you will get soaked. The park has beautiful nature trails that are free to explore and offer a peaceful break from crowds.

day_by_day.morning: Rest morning — sleep in and enjoy the Aegean Bliss Resort amenities. Take a morning swim, enjoy the beach/pool area, and have a leisurely breakfast. Use this time to do a quick grocery run to a nearby Walmart or Publix for snacks, drinks, and easy meals to save money for the rest of the trip.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit Disney Springs again for free entertainment and exploration. Check out the LEGO Store, World of Disney (largest Disney store in the world), and browse unique shops. Catch any free live music or street performances. Alternatively, revisit your favorite park for a half-day if your ticket allows.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Magic Kingdom for a second evening visit. Focus on anything you missed on Day 2. Ride Space Mountain at night, explore Main Street U.S.A., and watch the Electric Water Pageant from the shores near the resort hotels (free, visible from the Seven Seas Lagoon area around 9:00-9:30 PM).

meals.breakfast: Leisurely hotel breakfast or grocery store items like yogurt, fruit, and bagels (~$4-6)
meals.lunch: Disney Springs: Wolfgang Puck Express for wood-fired pizza and pasta at moderate prices (~$13-16), or grab a quick hot dog from a street cart (~$7-9)
meals.dinner: Magic Kingdom: Be Our Guest Restaurant for a special budget splurge — prix fixe dinner is pricier but worth it for the experience, OR stick to Casey's Corner hot dogs and corn dog nuggets for a very affordable classic Disney meal (~$9-12)

day_by_day.notes: This is your recovery and flexibility day. Don't feel pressured to fill every hour — Disney fatigue is real after 4 consecutive park days. The grocery run will save significant money on snacks and drinks for Day 7. A reusable insulated water bottle will save you from buying $5 bottles of water in the parks.

day_by_day.morning: Final park day — return to your favorite park or any park you want to revisit. Recommended: Go back to Magic Kingdom or EPCOT for a relaxed final morning. Ride your favorite attractions one last time. Pick up any last-minute souvenirs from the gift shops (budget tip: buy Disney merchandise at Disney Springs or the resort gift shop which sometimes has sales).
day_by_day.afternoon: Check out of Aegean Bliss Resort (standard checkout is 11:00 AM — store luggage with the bell desk if needed). Spend the early afternoon at the resort pool or Disney Springs for final shopping. Head to the airport with plenty of time — allow 2-3 hours before departure for Orlando International.
day_by_day.evening: Departure — fly home with magical memories! If your flight is late evening, grab a final affordable dinner near the airport at a local spot like 4 Rivers Smokehouse or a food court option at the airport.

meals.breakfast: Use up any remaining grocery store items or grab a quick hotel breakfast to save money on the last day (~$4-6)
meals.lunch: Final Disney meal — Pinocchio Village Haus at Magic Kingdom (great views of It's a Small World, affordable pasta and flatbreads, ~$12-15) or pack lunch from grocery items
meals.dinner: Airport dining or a nearby affordable restaurant — Chick-fil-A, Chipotle, or a local Orlando spot near the airport (~$10-14 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Budget summary tips for the week: Multi-day park tickets save significantly vs. single-day passes. Bringing a refillable water bottle saves $25-35 over the week. Packing snacks from a grocery store saves $15-20 per day. Free Disney resort transportation eliminates rideshare costs within the resort. The free My Disney Experience app is essential for maximizing your time and money. Total estimated daily budget per person (excluding park tickets): $40-60/day for food and incidentals.

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled — flight LH arrives at 13:00. Rest and travel time accounted for.
day_by_day.afternoon: Check in to Aegean Bliss Resort at Disney World. Settle into your Beachfront room, explore the resort amenities, pool area, and beach frontage. Pick up park tickets and review the week's park hours and FastPass/Lightning Lane reservations.
day_by_day.evening: Head to Disney Springs for a relaxed, no-ticket-required introduction to the Disney World atmosphere. Browse the shops, enjoy the waterfront ambiance, and ease into vacation mode after a long travel day.

meals.breakfast: Meal on the flight or grab a quick bite at the airport before departure.
meals.lunch: Grab a casual bite at the resort's poolside café or quick-service restaurant upon arrival — budget around $15–20 per person.
meals.dinner: The Boathouse at Disney Springs — a mid-range waterfront restaurant offering fresh seafood, steaks, and burgers with a fun nautical atmosphere. Expect $30–45 per person.

day_by_day.notes: Do not over-schedule Day 1. Jet lag and travel fatigue are real. Use the afternoon to rest, hydrate, and get your park app set up with Lightning Lane reservations for the rest of the week. Pick up any snacks or supplies at the resort marketplace.

day_by_day.morning: Magic Kingdom Park Full Day Experience — Arrive at rope drop (typically 8:00–9:00 AM) to beat the crowds. Start with Tomorrowland: Space Mountain and Buzz Lightyear's Space Ranger Spin. Move to Fantasyland for Seven Dwarfs Mine Train (use Lightning Lane) and Peter Pan's Flight.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue the Magic Kingdom Full Day Experience. Explore Adventureland (Pirates of the Caribbean, Jungle Cruise) and Liberty Square (Haunted Mansion). Grab a mid-afternoon snack and take a resort break from 2:00–4:30 PM to avoid peak heat and crowds, then return refreshed for the evening.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Magic Kingdom for the iconic evening spectaculars — TRON Lightcycle Run (Lightning Lane recommended), followed by the Disney Enchantment fireworks show over Cinderella Castle (typically 9:00 PM). End the night on a magical high note.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast at Aegean Bliss Resort's main dining area — continental or buffet option, budget $12–18 per person. Eat before rope drop.
meals.lunch: Columbia Harbour House in Liberty Square — a mid-range quick-service spot offering clam chowder, lobster rolls, and fried fish. Budget $15–20 per person.
meals.dinner: Be Our Guest Restaurant in Fantasyland (book in advance) — French-inspired cuisine in the Beast's enchanted castle. Mid-range dinner entrées $25–40 per person. Alternatively, Tony's Town Square Restaurant for Italian classics.

day_by_day.notes: Book Lightning Lane Multi Pass and individual Lightning Lane selections (Seven Dwarfs Mine Train, TRON) as early as possible — these sell out fast. Wear comfortable shoes and bring a portable fan/misting bottle as June temperatures in Orlando regularly reach 90°F+ with high humidity.

day_by_day.morning: Disney's Animal Kingdom Safari & Avatar Experience — Arrive early for Kilimanjaro Safaris (best wildlife activity in the morning when animals are most active). See elephants, giraffes, lions, zebras, and more in a live open-air safari truck. Follow with Gorilla Falls Exploration Trail for up-close wildlife viewing.
day_by_day.afternoon: Head to Pandora – The World of Avatar. Ride Avatar Flight of Passage (Lightning Lane strongly recommended — one of Disney World's most popular attractions) and Na'vi River Journey. Explore the stunning bioluminescent landscape of Pandora. Take time for the Dino-Land or Asia section if energy allows.
day_by_day.evening: Catch the Tree of Life Awakenings projection show as dusk falls — a beautiful, immersive experience unique to Animal Kingdom. Wind down the evening with a relaxed walk through Discovery Island before heading back to the resort.

meals.breakfast: Early resort breakfast — grab a quick grab-and-go option from the resort marketplace (muffins, fruit, coffee) to make rope drop. Budget $8–12 per person.
meals.lunch: Satu'li Canteen in Pandora — one of Disney World's best quick-service restaurants. Customizable bowls with proteins, grains, and sauces inspired by Avatar. Budget $15–20 per person.
meals.dinner: Yak & Yeti Restaurant in Asia section of Animal Kingdom — Pan-Asian cuisine in a beautifully themed setting. Mid-range table service, $25–40 per person. Book in advance.

day_by_day.notes: Avatar Flight of Passage is one of the most in-demand rides in all of Disney World. Secure a Lightning Lane Individual selection for this ride as soon as the park opens. Animal Kingdom typically closes earlier than other parks (around 7:00–8:00 PM), so plan accordingly.

day_by_day.morning: EPCOT World Showcase Food & Culture Tour — Arrive at EPCOT for opening and head to Future World first. Ride Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind (virtual queue or Lightning Lane — sign up immediately at park open) and Test Track. Then make your way to the World Showcase as it opens around 11:00 AM.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the EPCOT World Showcase promenade — all 11 country pavilions including Mexico, Norway (Frozen Ever After ride), China, Germany, Italy, America, Japan, Morocco, France, United Kingdom, and Canada. Sample authentic food and beverages from multiple countries as you stroll. This is the heart of the EPCOT Food & Culture experience.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for EPCOT's Harmonious nighttime spectacular over World Showcase Lagoon (one of the largest nighttime shows Disney has ever created). Enjoy a final drink or dessert at one of the World Showcase pavilions while watching the show.

meals.breakfast: Full resort breakfast at Aegean Bliss Resort dining room — fuel up for a long EPCOT day. Budget $15–20 per person.
meals.lunch: World Showcase grazing lunch — sample 3–4 small plates/snacks across different country pavilions (school bread in Norway, tacos in Mexico, crepes in France). Budget $20–30 per person for a satisfying multi-country lunch experience.
meals.dinner: Teppan Edo in the Japan Pavilion — a lively teppanyaki-style table service restaurant where chefs cook at your table. Great for families and entertainment. Budget $35–50 per person. Book well in advance.

day_by_day.notes: EPCOT is best enjoyed at a leisurely pace — don't rush the World Showcase. If traveling with children, the Norway pavilion's Frozen Ever After and the Mexico pavilion's Gran Fiesta Tour boat ride are family favorites. Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind uses a virtual queue system — check the My Disney Experience app the moment the park opens.

day_by_day.morning: Hollywood Studios Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge Adventure — Arrive at rope drop for Hollywood Studios. Head straight to Galaxy's Edge and join the virtual queue or Lightning Lane for Star Wars: Rise of the Resistance (one of the most immersive theme park experiences ever built). Experience the full immersion of Batuu.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue the Galaxy's Edge experience — visit Savi's Workshop to build a custom lightsaber (advance reservation required, $249.99 per lightsaber — optional splurge) or Droid Depot to build a custom droid ($119.99). Ride Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run. Then explore the rest of Hollywood Studios: Toy Story Land (Slinky Dog Dash, Toy Story Mania) and Tower of Terror.
day_by_day.evening: End the Hollywood Studios day with the stunning Star Wars: A Galactic Spectacular fireworks and projection show. Alternatively, catch Fantasmic! — a classic Hollywood Studios nighttime lagoon show featuring Mickey Mouse in an epic battle of imagination. Check the schedule as both shows may run on select evenings.

meals.breakfast: Grab a quick resort breakfast or continental option — aim to arrive at Hollywood Studios by 8:00–8:30 AM. Budget $10–15 per person.
meals.lunch: Docking Bay 7 Food and Cargo in Galaxy's Edge — themed quick-service with creative dishes like Smoked Kaadu Ribs and Fried Endorian Tip-Yip (chicken). Budget $15–22 per person. Fully immersive Star Wars dining experience.
meals.dinner: 50's Prime Time Café in Hollywood Studios — a nostalgic, fun table-service restaurant themed like a 1950s kitchen serving classic American comfort food (pot roast, meatloaf, fried chicken). Budget $25–35 per person. Great for families.

day_by_day.notes: Star Wars: Rise of the Resistance is the crown jewel of Galaxy's Edge and requires either a virtual queue boarding group (free, secured via app at park open) or a Lightning Lane Individual purchase. This is non-negotiable to experience — plan around it. The lightsaber building experience at Savi's Workshop is a memorable splurge for Star Wars fans.

day_by_day.morning: Resort Leisure Morning — Sleep in and enjoy a relaxed morning at Aegean Bliss Resort. Take advantage of the beachfront and pool area. This is a planned recovery day mid-trip to recharge before the final park day. Enjoy the resort's amenities, beach walk, or spa if available.
day_by_day.afternoon: Disney Springs Dining & Entertainment Afternoon — Head to Disney Springs for a free-admission, low-energy afternoon. Browse the 60+ shops including World of Disney (the largest Disney merchandise store in the world), LEGO Store, and unique boutiques. Enjoy the waterfront atmosphere and street entertainment.
day_by_day.evening: Disney Springs Entertainment Evening — Catch a show at the AMC Disney Springs 24 movie theater, visit the Splitsville Luxury Lanes bowling alley for a fun family activity, or enjoy live music at one of the waterfront venues. A perfect low-key evening before the final park day.

meals.breakfast: Leisurely resort breakfast — sit-down meal at the Aegean Bliss Resort restaurant. Enjoy the beachfront views. Budget $15–25 per person.
meals.lunch: D-Luxe Burger at Disney Springs — gourmet burgers, hand-cut fries, and craft milkshakes. Casual, mid-range, and delicious. Budget $15–20 per person.
meals.dinner: STK Orlando at Disney Springs — an upscale-casual steakhouse with a fun, modern atmosphere. A slight splurge for the trip's penultimate night. Budget $45–65 per person. Alternatively, Raglan Road Irish Pub for live Irish music, dancing, and hearty pub fare at $25–40 per person.

day_by_day.notes: Day 6 is intentionally lighter on park time. Six days of theme park touring is physically demanding — this recovery day prevents burnout and keeps the family energized for Day 7. Disney Springs requires no park ticket and is accessible via Disney transportation from most resorts. Check the Disney Springs entertainment schedule in advance.

day_by_day.morning: Return to your favorite park for a final morning — recommended: Magic Kingdom for any missed attractions or a nostalgic farewell ride on classics like Pirates of the Caribbean, Haunted Mansion, or It's a Small World. Alternatively, return to EPCOT for any missed World Showcase pavilions or Future World attractions.
day_by_day.afternoon: Final resort afternoon — check out or store luggage with the resort concierge. Spend the last afternoon at the Aegean Bliss Resort pool and beachfront. Soak in the Florida sun and reflect on the week's memories. Pick up any final souvenirs at the resort gift shop or Disney Springs if time allows.
day_by_day.evening: Farewell dinner at the resort or a nearby Orlando restaurant before departure or final night's rest. Pack, organize receipts, and prepare for departure the following day if flying home.

meals.breakfast: Final resort breakfast — treat yourself to a full sit-down meal. Budget $18–25 per person.
meals.lunch: Quick-service lunch inside the chosen park — Casey's Corner (hot dogs) or Pecos Bill Tall Tale Inn (Tex-Mex) at Magic Kingdom. Budget $12–18 per person.
meals.dinner: Celebration dinner at California Grill atop Disney's Contemporary Resort — a signature Disney dining experience with panoramic views of Magic Kingdom and the fireworks. A worthy splurge to close out the trip. Budget $60–90 per person. Advance reservation essential. Alternatively, 'Ohana at Disney's Polynesian Resort for a family-style feast ($45–55 per person).

day_by_day.notes: On the final day, prioritize experiences over logistics. Don't over-schedule — leave time for spontaneous moments, final photos at your favorite spots, and genuine relaxation. If departing on Day 7, confirm checkout time with Aegean Bliss Resort and arrange airport transportation in advance. Disney's Magical Express or a ride-share service to Orlando International Airport is recommended.

highlights: Mix of paid and free experiences

day_by_day.morning: Arrival & Resort Check-In: Flight LH lands at 13:00, so no morning activities scheduled. Private luxury transfer from Orlando International Airport to Aegean Bliss Resort at Disney World. Enjoy a seamless, chauffeur-driven arrival experience.
day_by_day.afternoon: Resort Orientation & Relaxation: Check into your premium Beachfront suite at Aegean Bliss Resort. Explore the resort amenities — pool, spa, and beachfront area. Unpack, freshen up, and acclimate to the Disney World atmosphere. Take a leisurely stroll around the resort grounds and enjoy welcome amenities.
day_by_day.evening: Disney Springs Dining & Entertainment Evening: Head to Disney Springs for a no-park-ticket-required luxury evening. Browse over 60 world-class shops and entertainment venues. Enjoy live music, waterfront views, and the vibrant atmosphere as a perfect gentle introduction to the Disney World experience.

meals.breakfast: Enjoy breakfast on the flight or grab a light snack upon landing at the airport lounge.
meals.lunch: Morimoto Asia at Disney Springs — celebrity chef Masaharu Morimoto's flagship restaurant offering exquisite Pan-Asian cuisine in a stunning two-story setting.
meals.dinner: STK Orlando at Disney Springs — upscale modern steakhouse with prime cuts, craft cocktails, and a lively rooftop terrace ambiance perfect for a first night celebration.

day_by_day.notes: Request early check-in in advance to ensure your suite is ready upon arrival. Ask the concierge to arrange Lightning Lane Multi Pass and Individual Lightning Lane selections for the upcoming park days. Confirm all park reservations for the week. Tip: Disney's Magical Express-style private transfers can be pre-booked through the resort concierge for a seamless luxury arrival.

day_by_day.morning: Magic Kingdom Park Full Day Experience — Morning Session: Arrive at Magic Kingdom at rope drop (typically 8:30–9:00 AM) to beat the crowds. Prioritize top-tier rides: Seven Dwarfs Mine Train, Space Mountain, and Big Thunder Mountain Railroad using Individual Lightning Lane passes. Explore Fantasyland and Tomorrowland with minimal wait times in the early hours.
day_by_day.afternoon: Magic Kingdom Park — Afternoon Session: After a midday resort break or in-park lunch, return refreshed for afternoon adventures. Catch the Festival of Fantasy Parade, visit Liberty Square and Frontierland, and experience the Haunted Mansion and Pirates of the Caribbean. Use Lightning Lane passes strategically for any remaining must-do attractions.
day_by_day.evening: Magic Kingdom Nighttime Spectacular: Stay for the iconic WISHES/Happily Ever After fireworks spectacular and the Main Street Electrical Parade. Secure a premium viewing spot near the Hub Grass area in front of Cinderella Castle for an unobstructed, magical fireworks experience.

meals.breakfast: Citricos or the resort's signature restaurant at Aegean Bliss Resort — enjoy a lavish à la carte breakfast before heading to the park.
meals.lunch: Be Our Guest Restaurant inside Magic Kingdom — dine inside the enchanted Beast's Castle with French-inspired cuisine in a breathtaking fairy-tale setting (reserve well in advance).
meals.dinner: Cinderella's Royal Table inside Magic Kingdom's Cinderella Castle — a once-in-a-lifetime premium dining experience with character meet-and-greets, prix-fixe menus, and panoramic views of the park.

day_by_day.notes: Book Cinderella's Royal Table and Be Our Guest Restaurant 60 days in advance as they sell out quickly. Wear comfortable premium walking shoes. Bring a portable fan and hydration pack given June heat. The resort concierge can arrange a private VIP Tour Guide through Disney's VIP Tour Services for an elevated, skip-the-line experience throughout the day.

day_by_day.morning: EPCOT World Showcase Food & Culture Tour — Morning: Arrive at EPCOT for early entry (benefit of staying at a Disney resort). Begin with Future World/World Discovery — explore Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind and Test Track using Lightning Lane. Then transition into the World Showcase as it opens at 11:00 AM, starting your international culinary journey.
day_by_day.afternoon: EPCOT World Showcase Deep Dive: Embark on a guided private food and culture tour through all 11 country pavilions — Mexico, Norway, China, Germany, Italy, America, Japan, Morocco, France, United Kingdom, and Canada. Sample authentic cuisine, wines, and cultural experiences at each pavilion. Don't miss the EPCOT International Food & Wine Festival offerings if running seasonally in June.
day_by_day.evening: EPCOT Harmonious / EPCOT Forever Nighttime Show: Conclude the day with EPCOT's spectacular World Showcase Lagoon nighttime show featuring massive floating set pieces, lasers, pyrotechnics, and a globally inspired musical score. Secure a premium World Showcase Plaza viewing spot for the best vantage point.

meals.breakfast: The Garden View Tea Room or resort breakfast at Aegean Bliss — a refined start before a day of international culinary exploration.
meals.lunch: Monsieur Paul at EPCOT's France Pavilion — a Michelin-caliber French restaurant on the second floor of the France Pavilion offering classic haute cuisine and an extensive wine list.
meals.dinner: Teppan Edo at EPCOT's Japan Pavilion — an elevated teppanyaki dining experience with theatrical tableside cooking, premium wagyu beef options, and sake pairings in an authentic Japanese setting.

day_by_day.notes: EPCOT's World Showcase is best explored at a leisurely pace — don't rush. Consider purchasing the EPCOT Food & Wine Festival Dining Package if available during your visit for reserved seating at the culinary demonstrations. A private sommelier-guided wine tour through the France and Italy pavilions can be arranged through Disney's special experiences team. Stay hydrated — June heat in Florida is intense.

day_by_day.morning: Hollywood Studios Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge Adventure — Morning: Arrive at Hollywood Studios at rope drop for maximum Galaxy's Edge access. Head immediately to Savi's Workshop to build a custom lightsaber — an immersive, premium experience (book in advance). Then board Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run for your first piloting mission through hyperspace.
day_by_day.afternoon: Hollywood Studios Full Immersion: Experience Star Wars: Rise of the Resistance — one of Disney's most technologically advanced and immersive attractions. Explore the full Galaxy's Edge land, visit Oga's Cantina for exotic cocktails and galactic atmosphere, and shop for premium Star Wars merchandise and droid-building experiences at the Droid Depot.
day_by_day.evening: Hollywood Studios Entertainment & Fantasmic!: Catch the Tower of Terror and Rock 'n' Roller Coaster in the evening hours with shorter wait times. End the night with Fantasmic! — Hollywood Studios' spectacular outdoor nighttime show featuring water screens, pyrotechnics, and beloved Disney characters in an epic battle of good vs. evil.

meals.breakfast: Breakfast at Aegean Bliss Resort's premium restaurant — fuel up with a hearty, luxurious spread before a full day of galactic adventure.
meals.lunch: Oga's Cantina for exotic galactic cocktails and snacks, followed by a proper lunch at Docking Bay 7 Food and Cargo inside Galaxy's Edge — the most authentic Star Wars dining experience on the planet.
meals.dinner: Hollywood Brown Derby at Hollywood Studios — inspired by the legendary 1930s Hollywood icon, this upscale restaurant offers classic American cuisine with a modern twist, including the famous Cobb Salad prepared tableside.

day_by_day.notes: Savi's Workshop lightsaber building costs approximately $250 per lightsaber and must be reserved well in advance — it sells out weeks ahead. Oga's Cantina requires advance reservations and has a limited stay policy. Consider the Fantasmic! Dining Package for guaranteed premium seating at the show. The VIP Tour experience is particularly valuable at Hollywood Studios given the popularity of Star Wars attractions.

day_by_day.morning: Disney's Animal Kingdom Safari & Avatar Experience — Morning: Arrive at Animal Kingdom at rope drop for the Kilimanjaro Safaris, best experienced in the cooler morning hours when animals are most active. Witness free-roaming African wildlife — elephants, giraffes, lions, rhinos, and hundreds of other species — across a stunning 110-acre savanna. Follow with the Gorilla Falls Exploration Trail.
day_by_day.afternoon: Pandora — The World of Avatar: Immerse yourself in the bioluminescent world of Pandora. Experience Avatar Flight of Passage — arguably Disney World's greatest ride — soaring on the back of a banshee over the alien moon's breathtaking landscapes. Then glide through the bioluminescent rivers on Na'vi River Journey. Explore the Pandora landscape which transforms dramatically in the afternoon light.
day_by_day.evening: Animal Kingdom Evening & Resort Relaxation: Animal Kingdom typically closes earlier than other parks. Return to Aegean Bliss Resort for an indulgent evening. Enjoy the resort's luxury spa with a signature treatment, relax at the beachfront pool under the stars, or enjoy a private cabana experience as a perfect mid-trip reset.

meals.breakfast: Boma — Flavors of Africa at Disney's Animal Kingdom Lodge (nearby) — an award-winning African-inspired breakfast buffet featuring exotic fruits, specialty breads, and unique flavors from across the African continent.
meals.lunch: Tiffins Restaurant at Animal Kingdom — Disney World's most sophisticated Animal Kingdom dining experience, featuring globally inspired cuisine in an elegant, art-filled setting with artifacts from Disney Imagineers' worldwide travels. Order the whole-roasted cauliflower or the sustainable fish.
meals.dinner: Jiko — The Cooking Place at Disney's Animal Kingdom Lodge — one of Disney World's most celebrated fine dining restaurants, offering an African and Mediterranean-influenced menu with an award-winning all-African wine list in a stunning, fire-lit atmosphere.

day_by_day.notes: Kilimanjaro Safaris is best at rope drop when animals are most active and temperatures are cooler — this is critical in June. Avatar Flight of Passage Lightning Lane is essential as standby waits can exceed 2–3 hours. The resort spa should be booked in advance for evening treatments. Consider a private after-hours Animal Kingdom experience if available through Disney's special events program.

day_by_day.morning: Leisure Morning & Resort Luxury Experience: Enjoy a rare, unscheduled morning. Sleep in and indulge in a premium in-room breakfast delivered by butler service. Spend the morning at the Aegean Bliss Resort's beachfront — swim, paddleboard, or simply relax in a private cabana with personalized service. This mid-trip morning of rest is essential for recharging before the final park day.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to Favorite Parks or Disney Springs Shopping: Based on the family's preferences, revisit a favorite park to catch any missed experiences, or spend a leisurely afternoon at Disney Springs. Explore luxury boutiques like Pandora Jewelry, Chapel Hats, and the World of Disney flagship store. Visit the LEGO Store, Splitsville Luxury Lanes bowling, or catch a film at the AMC Disney Springs 24 theatre.
day_by_day.evening: Disney Springs Grand Farewell Dinner & Entertainment: Spend a magical final full evening at Disney Springs enjoying world-class entertainment. Catch a Cirque du Soleil 'Drawn to Life' performance — a groundbreaking show blending acrobatics, storytelling, and Disney animation in an intimate custom-built theater.

meals.breakfast: In-suite butler breakfast at Aegean Bliss Resort — fresh-squeezed juices, artisan pastries, eggs Benedict, and premium coffee service delivered to your beachfront suite.
meals.lunch: The BOATHOUSE at Disney Springs — waterfront dining featuring premium seafood, USDA prime steaks, and the unique opportunity to ride in authentic antique amphicars on the water. Request a waterfront table for the full experience.
meals.dinner: Maria & Enzo's Ristorante at Disney Springs — an elegant Italian restaurant set in a beautifully restored 1930s airline terminal. Enjoy handcrafted pastas, wood-fired dishes, and an extensive Italian wine cellar in one of Disney Springs' most atmospheric settings.

day_by_day.notes: Book Cirque du Soleil 'Drawn to Life' tickets well in advance — premium reserved seating is available and highly recommended for the best sightlines. The BOATHOUSE amphicar rides are a unique and memorable family experience — reserve these separately. Use this day as a flexible buffer day to revisit any park highlights missed earlier in the trip or to simply recharge in luxury.

day_by_day.morning: Magic Kingdom Grand Finale Morning: Return to Magic Kingdom for one final morning of magic. Experience any remaining bucket-list attractions and revisit family favorites. Take a horse-drawn trolley down Main Street U.S.A., visit the Emporium for last-minute premium souvenirs, and capture final family photos in front of Cinderella Castle.
day_by_day.afternoon: Resort Farewell & Spa Indulgence: Check out of Aegean Bliss Resort (arrange late checkout through concierge if flight permits). Enjoy a final luxury spa session or poolside afternoon. Pack and prepare for departure. Have the concierge arrange all luggage handling and private transfer logistics to Orlando International Airport.
day_by_day.evening: Private Transfer to Orlando International Airport: Depart in style via pre-arranged private luxury chauffeur transfer to the airport. Arrive with ample time for premium check-in and lounge access. Reflect on an extraordinary week of Disney magic, world-class dining, and unforgettable family memories.

meals.breakfast: Chef Mickey's at Disney's Contemporary Resort — the ultimate Disney character breakfast experience featuring Mickey, Minnie, Donald, Goofy, and Pluto in a fun, energetic setting perfect for a celebratory final morning.
meals.lunch: Columbia Harbour House or The Plaza Restaurant on Main Street U.S.A. at Magic Kingdom — a charming, sit-down Victorian-era restaurant for a relaxed final in-park lunch with classic American fare.
meals.dinner: Airport dining or pre-departure meal at Aeroporto — if time allows before departure, enjoy a farewell dinner at one of Orlando Airport's premium dining options, or arrange a special in-lounge dining experience through your airline's first-class lounge.

day_by_day.notes: Request late checkout (2:00–4:00 PM) from Aegean Bliss Resort concierge at the start of the trip to maximize your final day. Ensure all purchased merchandise and souvenirs are properly packed — Disney can arrange package delivery directly to your resort throughout the week so you're not carrying bags in the parks. Confirm private transfer timing to allow at least 3 hours before international departure. Consider purchasing a Disney Memory Maker package at the start of the trip to capture all professional in-park photos throughout the week as a premium keepsake of your family's magical journey.
